title: TMP36 fails on over-voltage or sustained reverse supply

implements.text: The sensor latches burnt when its supply exceeds vabs (default 7 V) or is reversed by more than 0.5 V for 3 s

mocked.text: Once the rule fires the part stays burnt until it is repaired; the real part may survive or fail more slowly

unsupported.text: Thermal history; only the threshold and its dwell are checked

parameterSources.note: absolute maximum supply of the device; datasheet page not cited

validation.dataset: figures/engine/bench-solve.test.mjs: the TMP36 drives A0 to 0.5 V + 10 mV per degC

knownFailureCases: The 3 s reverse window has no source
